item.text:
C1 will use M70 as its sole parent. I’ll replace Melantha and Spot with Cardigan, move Midnight to the lower lane, and split the physicians between upper and lower duties. Steward will remain in the upper position for roadblock #3, artillery exposure, and upper central armor; Midnight will own roadblock #4 and lower central assistance. This tests a new seven-ID formation; it does not establish an improvement over prior results.

I’ll include the structured decision record in the validation card. The critical test is whether changed shell exposure preserves healing and output long enough to kill artillery and settle both central lanes.

plan.tactical_thesis: Single-parent M70 duty consolidation: remove Melantha and Spot; Cardigan holds upper outer with self-recovery, Midnight holds lower outer and assists both central rows. Separated physicians support their assigned lanes. Persistent upper Steward destroys device3, attacks artillery during actual range exposure and clears upper armor; Midnight owns device4 and lower arts assistance. Every closure is a simulation prediction.

formation_structure.medical_geometry: Ansel[2,7]LEFT covers upper outer[1,5], Fang[3,5], Steward[2,5], himself. Hibiscus[5,3]RIGHT covers Friston[4,5], Midnight[6,5], herself. Tile separation is a geometric prediction; actual injured eligibility, selection and HEAL must be observed.

comparisons.reason: Verified failure evidence leaves artillery and central closure open.
Changes self-recovery, output and shell exposure while assigning both restraints and central rows.

formation_structure.economy: Initial10; Fang runtime cost10, Friston3, Midnight16, Cardigan18, each physician17, Steward18. Fang automatic grants required; no death refund or opening retreat credited. Late same-ID redeployments have2101-frame gaps; DP cost/refund is checked by production gate.

formation_transitions.transition: Midnight takes lower and central ranged assistance.
Steward takes upper device/artillery/central output, with upper physician already deployed.
Midnight second arts window for lower armor and mixed queues.
Fixed living withdrawals of Steward and Midnight at9000/9001 require completed hostile duty; failure does not reschedule.
Full2101-frame gaps; Steward clears western1, Midnight clears western2.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: No combat allocation for zero-length placeholder.
Steward persistent upper artillery output; Midnight may assist only when actual target is in range and own queue permits. Require actual artillery ENEMY_DEATH.
Steward clears eastern3, then western1 after hostiles settled; Cardigan intercepts upper officers; protected3 must survive and reach.
Midnight clears eastern4, then western2 after hostiles settled; he intercepts lower officers; protected14 must survive and reach.
Fang blocks upper central, Steward kills21/33; Midnight may assist while available. Actual block and kill or live replacement required.
Friston blocks lower central; Fang and Midnight supply damage, Midnight second arts window closes22 before34 needs a slot and then34. Hibiscus sustains actual recipients.
Cardigan blocks upper outer, self-recovers and receives Ansel healing; Steward can assist within actual range.
Midnight blocks/kills lower outer before leaving; Hibiscus heals; his blocked targets may delay central/device attacks.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish four interceptions, both physicians and eastern4 output without assuming M70 event deadlines.
Observe upper device3, artillery output and survival; preserve both protected targets; hold21/22.
Settle21/22/33/34 and all officers/runners with actual damage and healing; no live replacement is silently supplied.
Complete cooldowns, clear western1/2, observe both protected arrivals and no active enemies.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic income while alive and deployed.
No unsupported talent credited.
Manual40% self-heal every601frames from1600; redundant recovery is permitted but not evidence of need or delivery.
40-second arts windows separated by at least2101 inactive recovery frames.
Upper output and self-survival; no probabilistic extra heal.
Lower medical throughput; target choice must be observed.
Automatic enhanced attacks and high-defense priority; artillery may compete with armor.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Ordinary catalog debug configurations only; union seven IDs; no forbidden device tiles.
All actions fixed; no hidden repair or conditional rescheduling.
Both protected targets alive and reached, all four devices settled; civilian roadblock delay is not safe passage.
Actual block/kill21/22/33/34, zero leaks. No unassigned replacement.
Simulator WIN, life3, zero leaks,33 hostile kills,no active enemy, complete settlement.
Old frames are observations, not new deadlines. HP, full eligible order and continuous positions remain UNKNOWN when unrecorded.
